cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - StorageRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageRack to store boxes and trays which have their own floor
Drawers are not included:
![Inside](static/samples/StorageRack-2.jpg) ![Back wall details](static/samples/StorageRack-3.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageRack --x 140 --depth 180 --sh '40*4' --rail 25 --outside 0 --bottom_edge e --top_edge e --thickness 4 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes StorageRack --x --depth --sh --rail --outside --bottom_edge --top_edge --thickness --burn --reference --labels
